_doc: One entry per guild page (/fable/, /nightshift/): name and server shown on the site, faction (alliance or horde: PvP rank badges in ranks/ or ranks/horde/), tagline under the name on the home page. wip: text of the Work in progress banner, for a guild whose logs are not crawled yet (mock data, python -m pipeline.mock_site_data --guild nightshift). expansions: the expansions a guild has raided so far (the first ones, in order; all of them when absent): the other expansions, their tiers and the classes they bring (Death Knight, Monk) leave the filters. Site texts may use {guild}, replaced by the name when the data loads.

fable.name: Fable
fable.tagline: Seven years of raiding, from Molten Core to Siege of Orgrimmar. Every pull, every wipe, every questionable decision.

nightshift.name: NightShift
nightshift.tagline: Every pull, every wipe, every questionable decision. For the Horde.
nightshift.wip: NightShift's logs are not crawled yet: every name and number on this page is a placeholder.
